priority_tier: Priority #1: Core Volume Segment (35% of Customers)
main_case_need: Play with friends and enjoy the atmosphere
demographics:
- Age 21 to 32 office & agency staff
- Socializes in 4 to 8 friend groups
- Monthly income 12M to 30M VND
schedule_habit:
- Plays 2.0 visits per month
- Books late afternoons & evenings
- Highest food & drink spend (11.5k/visit)
pain_points:
- Cheaper peak rivals tempt groups away
- Last-minute 4th-player dropouts
- No loyalty perks for repeat bookings
derived_demand:
- Easy group booking & bill splitting
- Drop-in open play to fill 4-player games
- Lively cafe hangout & member perks

priority_tier: Priority #2: High-Churn Trial Segment (30% of Customers)
main_case_need: Try something seen online; many visit once or twice
demographics:
- Age 18 to 26 students & young creators
- Discovers pickleball on TikTok & IG
- Flexible daytime hours, budget-aware
schedule_habit:
- Plays only 1.1 visits per month
- Most visit once or twice then churn
- Highest paddle rental spend (5.2k/visit)
pain_points:
- Highest Marketing Cost (6,313 VND/visit)
- 160k daytime rate is too high for students
- Intimidated by experienced players
derived_demand:
- Affordable weekday daytime student rates
- Beginner-only social mixer sessions
- Easy starter equipment & 2nd-visit hook

main_case_need: Improve skills and find good opponents
demographics:
- Age 24 to 38 urban professionals
- Former tennis and badminton players
- Monthly income 25M to 60M+ VND
schedule_habit:
- Plays 4.5 visits per month
- Books prime weekday evenings & weekends
- Owns personal carbon paddles
pain_points:
- Evening courts are 95% full at peak
- Hard to find equal-skill 4th players
- Lacks structured ranked leagues
derived_demand:
- Skill-verified 4-player matchmaking
- Reliable peak court availability
- Ranked leagues & advanced drills

priority_tier: Tier 3: High-Ancillary Coaching Segment (15% of Customers)
main_case_need: A welcoming activity and beginner lessons
demographics:
- Parents age 33 to 50 with kids age 8 to 16
- Affluent urban HCMC households
- Values safety, shade & coaching
schedule_habit:
- Plays 1.2 visits per month on weekends
- Prefers morning & afternoon slots
- Highest coaching spend (25.2k/visit)
pain_points:
- Fast adult games intimidate children
- Lacks structured junior lesson tracks
- Needs shaded family seating areas
derived_demand:
- Dedicated family & junior beginner lessons
- Safe weekend family court blocks
- Shaded spectator seating & refreshments
